name: The Campus Creature
source:
You play as Xander, a young man starting his first semester of college. While trying to rebrand himself and put his disreputable high school days behind him, he ends up discovering a creature on campus. 

[From [url=https://rediumrum.itch.io/the-campus-creature]itch.io[/url]]
